beats.say: Clicked a link or typed your password? It can happen to anyone.
The first fifteen minutes matter most: stolen passwords are often used right away.
Change the password on the real site, tell security and keep the email.
Do not hide it. Silence gives the attacker time; an honest report protects everyone.

scenes.title: You typed your password
scenes.intro: You typed your mail password on a fake page and have just realised it. The next steps are yours.

body.text: Wrong password. Try again or use another password.

actions.label: Try again
actions.feedback: Fake sites show an error so you type the password again, sometimes a different one too.

actions.label: Close
actions.feedback: Right, type nothing more. Close the page and move to the next step.

body.text: Increase your storage so mail is not deleted:

steps.say: The email is still in your inbox.

actions.label: Report phishing
actions.feedback: Right. Your report lets security remove the email from other inboxes too.

actions.label: Forward to security
actions.feedback: Good. Do this if there is no report button, then call them too.

actions.label: Delete it so nobody sees
actions.feedback: The email is evidence. Deleted, it cannot help security trace the attack.

steps.say: You typed the address yourself. Change the password.

actions.label: Change password
actions.feedback: Right, the site is genuine. The new password must not resemble the old one.

actions.label: I'll change it tomorrow
actions.feedback: Stolen passwords are used fast. Waiting gives the attacker time.

body.text: Your old mail password is also used on the office portal and the Kontakto page.

actions.label: Change all
actions.feedback: Right. Attackers try a stolen password on other sites too.

actions.label: Later
actions.feedback: Every account with the same password is now exposed. Change them all today.

scenes.prompt: Match each mistake with the first step.

pairs.right: Close the page and report the email

pairs.left: I typed my password on a fake page
pairs.right: Change it on the real site and report

pairs.left: I gave a caller my verification code

pairs.right: Call the bank on the number on your card

scenes.explain: Report it every time: specialists check for traces you cannot see.

question.prompt: A sign-in request came to your phone and you tapped "Approve" by mistake. What now?

options.label: I call security right away and change my password
options.feedback: Right. You let the attacker in; security will throw them out by ending the sessions.

options.label: Nothing, it was only once
options.feedback: One approval is enough: the attacker is already in your account.

options.label: I switch off the phone
options.feedback: Turning off the phone does not remove the attacker. They are already in.

scenes.explain: A mistaken approval and a code given away need the same urgent step: report at once.

scenes.prompt: Create a new password to replace the stolen one: nothing like the old one.
tips: Do not just tweak the old one: Aysel2027 instead of Aysel2026 will not do
Join four random words with spaces
Save the new password in the password manager

points: Type nothing more: close the page and keep the email.
Change the password on the real site, and wherever else you used it.
Gave a code or tapped approve? Call security right away.
